youtube.baslik: Why should a baby arrive sleepy for an ABR test? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The ABR is easily disturbed by muscle activity, so the baby needs to sleep deeply and calmly. In the first months, the test is often done in natural sleep; the family is asked to keep the baby awake before arriving and to feed the baby at the clinic.
